resources.convention: Write the backend secure by default. Validate every input from outside at the system boundary with an allow list (type, length, format, valid values), not only in the UI. Authorize on the server with deny by default, and for a sensitive operation check both the identity and the permission (one user must not be able to read or change another user's resource by guessing an ID). Do not expose stack traces, internal IDs or personal data in responses and logs. Secrets come from environment variables or a secret store, never from code or from a committed config file. Hash passwords with a slow salted algorithm (Argon2id or bcrypt). Add a dependency only when needed and pin its version. If the project has no authentication yet, state that as a known limitation instead of inventing a mechanism.
